tools.name: claude_code
tools.description: Send a task to an autonomous Claude Code agent. It reads/writes files, runs shell commands, searches codebases, and handles complex software engineering tasks end-to-end. Returns the result text plus a session_id for follow-ups via claude_code_reply.

prompt.description: Task or question for Claude Code

run_id.description: Workflow run ID — groups related agent calls into one timeline. Auto-generated if omitted; returned in every response for propagation.

tools.description: Restrict available tools to this list (intersects with server-level restriction)

disallowedTools.description: Additional tools to block (unions with server-level blacklist)

additionalDirs.description: Extra directories the agent can access for this invocation

plugins.description: Additional plugin paths to load for this invocation (unions with server-level plugins)

permissionMode.description: Permission mode override (can only tighten, never loosen)

systemPrompt.description: Additional system prompt (appended to server default)

tools.name: claude_code_reply
tools.description: Continue a previous claude_code conversation by session ID. Use this for follow-up questions, iterative refinement, or multi-step workflows that build on prior context.

session_id.description: Session ID from a prior claude_code response

run_id.description: Workflow run ID — pass the same run_id from the original call to keep entries grouped.

tools.name: claude_code_timeline
tools.description: Query the cross-agent workflow timeline. No args: list all runs. run_id: show one run's agent sequence. session_id: retrieve timeline entry and session metadata. Use claude_code_transcript for full transcripts.

run_id.description: Show all entries for this workflow run, ordered by time

session_id.description: Retrieve timeline entry and session metadata for a specific session

tools.name: claude_code_transcript
tools.description: Retrieve the full conversation transcript for a session from Claude Code's storage. Returns chronological user/assistant messages. Use session_id from a prior query or timeline lookup.

session_id.description: Session ID to retrieve transcript for

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return

offset.description: Skip this many messages from the start

tools.name: claude_code_sessions
tools.description: List Claude Code interactive session history, newest first. Scoped to the current project directory by default; pass all_projects=true to list sessions across every project on this machine. Returns session_id, title, first prompt, git branch, timestamps, and file size for each session. Pass a returned session_id to claude_code_transcript to read the full conversation.

all_projects.description: List sessions from every project on this machine instead of just the current one (default: false)

cwd.description: Project directory to list sessions for (default: the server's working directory). Ignored when all_projects is true.

limit.description: Maximum number of sessions to return

offset.description: Skip this many sessions from the start, for pagination (default: 0)

include_worktrees.description: When listing one project, also include sessions from its sibling git worktrees (default: true)

tools.name: claude_code_report
tools.description: Generate a self-contained HTML report of a workflow run. No args: list all runs. run_id: detailed report for that run with agent sequence, cost breakdown, and collapsible transcripts. Save the returned HTML to a file and open in a browser.

run_id.description: Generate detailed report for this run. Omit to list all runs.

include_transcripts.description: Include full session transcripts in run reports (default: true, requires session persistence)
